summary: Practise job evaluation, salary range reviews and benefits administration in five days. Explore the compensation and benefits training outline.
lede: Compensation training gives HR, payroll and reward professionals a consistent method for making and documenting routine pay and benefits decisions. Participants practise evaluating roles with point-factor criteria, matching jobs to salary survey data, calculating compa-ratios and reviewing salary ranges. They also check benefits eligibility and enrolment records, and prepare decision notes that explain pay changes and support manager queries.
audienceIntro: This course suits people who handle pay, job data or employee benefits and need a consistent foundation for routine decisions. It is designed for HR and reward roles working directly with compensation administration, employee records or benefits processes.
modules: Salary Survey Matching and Market Data
Pay Pattern Review and Equity Checks
prerequisites: Recommended background: exposure to HR, payroll or benefits administration. No coding is required; exercises use basic spreadsheet calculations. Advanced topics such as incentive design and benefits costing receive conceptual or foundation-level coverage, not technical implementation.
